script:
exact match xs, h with
| [], h => absurd rfl h
| [x], _ => ⟨x, by simp⟩
| x :: y :: t, _ =>
  let r := listMax (y :: t) (by simp)
  ⟨max x r.val, by
    have h1 := r.property.1
    have h2 := r.property.2
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · rcases Int.le_total x r.val with h | h
      · rw [Int.max_eq_right h]; exact List.mem_cons_of_mem _ h1
      · rw [Int.max_eq_left h]; exact List.mem_cons_self
    · intro z hz
      rcases List.mem_cons.mp hz with rfl | hz
      · omega
      · have := h2 z hz; omega⟩
spec_check: Spec is satisfiable and non-vacuous: max of a nonempty list exists.
